all_prime_theorems.bounded_prefactor_no_go: if Q_p in Q(z) and abs(vdeg Q_p)<=M independent of p, then abs(vdeg(Q_p*N_p))>=2*(p-1)-M
all_prime_theorems.fixed_rank_conclusion: no uniformly bounded finite-rank graded determinant can realize Q_p*N_p
all_prime_theorems.normalized_euler_germ: product_p G_p(p^(-s)) converges locally uniformly and is nonzero for Re(s)>1/2
all_prime_theorems.normalized_root_determinant_gate: G_p is an ordinary rational determinant only if every divisor multiplicity of N_p is divisible by d_p
all_prime_theorems.ordinary_norm_euler_germ: product_p N_p(p^(-s)) converges locally uniformly and is nonzero for Re(s)>1

definitions.chronology: all B_p,n retain the rho-twisted ordered 2n-step Henon phase

material_passport.evidence_policy: exact all-prime degree argument plus exact chronological finite controls; no zero-table data

route_a.A2_reason: ordinary norm is rational and gives an Euler germ on Re(s)>1; normalized root improves to Re(s)>1/2 but is not yet an ordinary determinant
route_a.A3_reason: normalized Log_0 norm reaches the critical-boundary half-plane, while continuation, functional equation, and divisor integrality remain open
